jobs.company: Mission Technologies, a division of HII
jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 29869

Required Travel: 0 - 10%

Employment Type: Full Time/Salaried/Exempt

Anticipated Salary Range: $74,984.00 - $100,000.00

Security Clearance: TS/SCI

Level of Experience: Mid

Meet HII’s Mission Technologies Division

Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense – the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that’s right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

HII Mission Technologies is seeking an experienced Facility Manager with Facility Security Officer (FSO) experience to oversee the daily operation, maintenance, readiness, and security of a 5,000–10,000 square-foot commercial facility supporting customer mission activities.

The facility supports a dynamic operational environment that includes identity and signature risk management, operational planning, and related technical support capabilities. The Facility Manager plays an important role in maintaining the infrastructure, security, readiness, and professional operating environment necessary to enable these activities and support customer requirements.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in facility operations, property and asset management, building maintenance, vendor coordination, space management, safety and regulatory compliance, and facility security. This position requires an individual who demonstrates initiative, accountability, sound judgment, organization, consistency, and follow-through, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities in a mission-focused environment.

The position will also perform designated Facility Security Officer responsibilities, including personnel security, physical security, document control, visitor control, and implementation of applicable government and corporate security requirements.

Professional and Operational Expectations

The Successful Candidate Must Be Capable Of Operating With a High Degree Of Independence And Personal Accountability In a Mission-focused Environment. The Individual Should Demonstrate The Ability To

  • Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and ensure requirements are followed through to completion.
  • Independently organize, prioritize, and manage multiple concurrent requirements.
  • Maintain consistent and dependable performance across facility and security responsibilities.
  • Anticipate requirements and proactively identify issues that could affect personnel, security, infrastructure, or mission operations.
  • Exercise sound judgment when determining priorities, resolving problems, and escalating concerns.
  • Communicate emerging issues, risks, delays, and requirements in a timely manner.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with employees, leadership, customers, government representatives, property management, vendors, and contractors.
  • Maintain accurate records and provide clear and timely status updates.
  • Adapt to changing priorities and operational requirements while maintaining accountability for ongoing responsibilities.
  • Demonstrate a professional, responsive, customer-focused approach to facility and security support.
  • Understand the relationship between facility readiness and mission readiness and prioritize responsibilities accordingly.
  • Identify opportunities to improve facility operations, processes, efficiency, reliability, and customer support.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Facilities Management and Operations

  • Oversee daily operation, maintenance, readiness, and professional appearance of the facility. Manage opening/closing procedures and ensure the facility remains safe, secure, functional, and mission-ready.
  • Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance for HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, fire/life-safety, security, and building systems. Develop maintenance schedules and ensure inspections, servicing, repairs, and corrective actions are completed.
  • Serve as primary facility point of contact with property management, landlords, building engineers, utilities, contractors, vendors, and service providers. Manage facility service providers for janitorial, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, pest control, waste management, and security systems. Monitor vendor performance and ensure compliance with requirements.
  • Conduct routine facility inspections to identify maintenance, safety, security, housekeeping, infrastructure, and operational deficiencies. Track issues and coordinate corrective actions through resolution.
  • Manage space utilization, workspace assignments, office configurations, storage areas, and common spaces. Coordinate employee moves, workspace modifications, furniture installation, and equipment placement.
  • Plan and coordinate facility repairs, renovations, infrastructure improvements, and projects. Support development of scopes of work, cost estimates, schedules, and requirements.
  • Maintain inventory and accountability of facility furniture, equipment, IT devices, keys, access devices, and assigned property. Maintain accurate facility records including maintenance documentation, inspection records, service agreements, warranties, equipment information, and floor plans.
  • Support facility budgets, expenditure tracking, forecasting, invoice validation, and cost-saving opportunities. Monitor utilities and identify efficiency, reliability, and sustainability improvements.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, NFPA, ADA, environmental, fire/life-safety, corporate, and government requirements. Coordinate required inspections and address deficiencies.
  • Support emergency preparedness, evacuation, continuity, and recovery planning. Coordinate response to facility outages, equipment failures, and infrastructure issues affecting personnel or operations.
  • Develop and maintain facility SOPs, checklists, emergency procedures, and operational documentation. Proactively identify potential risks, deficiencies, and emerging needs.
  • Provide leadership timely updates on facility issues, projects, risks, costs,...

jobs.title: Security Guard - Part Time Mobile Rounds
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Guard - Part Time Mobile Security Rounds in San Antonio, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $14.00 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeWed12:00 PM - 08:00 PM

How This Role Works

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service to clients, employees, visitors, and contractors while carrying out site-specific security-related procedures, policies, and emergency response activities.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols throughout office areas, common spaces, parking areas, and the property perimeter to help identify and report unusual conditions.
  • Monitor access points, visitor activity, and security-related systems in accordance with site procedures; report unauthorized access attempts or irregular activity.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established escalation and reporting protocols.
  • Document patrols, incidents, observations, and daily activities accurately and communicate relevant information to site leadership and Allied Universal supervision.

Minimum Requirements

  • A valid driver’s license is required in the state where the job is located.
  • Ability to lift up to 20 pounds is preferred.
  • CPR certification is preferred.
  • Comfortable using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices. C15802

POSITION SUMMARY INFORMATION: DUTIES AND REQUIREMENTS

Job Summary:

The Armed Security Guard is responsible for providing essential, high-level armed security services at an assigned U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Service (USCIS) government facility. This role involves maintaining a visible presence, controlling access, screening visitors, and responding to incidents in strict compliance with federal contract requirements and Agency Security Classification (ASC) procedures. Guards work on-site, typically as part of a two-person team.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Perform continuous access control duties, including screening visitors and personnel using walk-through magnetometers and hand-held detection wands.
  • Conduct regular facility checks, monitor surveillance systems, and ensure the overall security and integrity of the assigned USCIS site.
  • Respond promptly and appropriately to all security incidents, emergencies, and alarms according to established post orders and emergency response plans.
  • Accurately and thoroughly document all activities, incidents, and security breaches in daily and incident reports.
  • Provide professional and courteous service while enforcing security protocols for all agency personnel and visitors.
  • Maintain proficiency in the proper setup, calibration, and operation of all assigned security equipment, including screening devices.
  • Ensure personal compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, and all site-specific Post Orders.
  • Work effectively with the assigned partner guard and communicate clearly with the designated Regional Security Manager regarding any operational or personnel issues.

Required Education, Certifications, Licenses, and Experience:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English proficiently.
  • Must have minimum of two (2) years of armed, relevant security experience from a military, law enforcement, or commercial armed guard background.
  • Must legally own and possess a registered approved 9mm semiautomatic pistol or .45 ACP handgun.
  • Must possess and maintain an active State Security Guard License for the state of the assigned post.
  • Must possess and maintain an active State Firearms License (or equivalent permit/qualification) for the state of the assigned post.
  • Must maintain current firearm qualifications, first-aid/CPR certifications, and complete annual use-of-force training and de-escalation training consistent with federal, state, and local requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience in the operation, calibration, and maintenance of walk-through metal detectors (magnetometers) and hand-held detection wands.
  • Must be able to stand and patrol for extended periods and perform duties requiring physical exertion in response to security incidents.
  • Must successfully complete USCIS Office of Security and Integrity (OSI) suitability screening and background checks prior to assignment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for reporting and interaction with the public.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and reliable transportation to the assigned site.

Work Environment:

Employees may be exposed to extreme cold or hot weather conditions, fumes, or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, and loud noise.

Physical Requirements:

Employees may be required to remain in a stationary position, stand, push, pull, climb, kneel, crawl, balance, squat, bend, and reach during shifts. Employees may be also required to use gear to move items around, including, but not limited to, carts and dollies. Employees may also be occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 49 pounds.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Armed Security Officer - Full Time Mobile Patrol in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Aero/Defense, and more. As an Armed Patrol Officer at a dynamic aerospace and defense location, you will conduct routine patrols, operate a vehicle as part of assigned duties, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide outstanding customer service and communication. Join Allied Universal’s agile, reliable, and innovative team, where a caring culture, teamwork, and integrity guide every security-related responsibility.

jobs.description:
Job Description

California applicants: Please click here to review the Costco Applicant Privacy Notice.

The jobs listed are examples of the typical kinds of positions that Costco may hire for when openings exist. The listing does not mean that any positions are currently open or available at Costco.

Position Summary

Protects company assets from internal and external theft. Reviews individual warehouse inventory numbers and assists in creating / executing a plan of action to reduce shrink. Is familiar with various facets of operation that contribute to shrink and participates in instruction and training with affected employees. Observes and reports potential safety and security hazards. Investigates, detains suspects, completes reports, cooperates with local law enforcement, and testifies in court if necessary. Reports directly to the Warehouse Manager. Provides a high level of member service.

Job Duties

  • Walks the warehouse and perimeter up to 8 hours a day to monitor safety and security concerns. Pushes cart with merchandise and returns items to the floor. Maintains anonymity by shopping amongst members.
  • Follows and maintains knowledge of Costco procedures and applicable laws in performance of duties. Attends meetings and seminars regarding loss prevention.
  • Observes, detects, and investigates internal and external theft threats as well as safety concerns. Retrieves stolen items which shoplifters have concealed; may need to move product to access stolen items.
  • Detains and interviews shoplifters when warranted. Reports potential internal theft situations to the warehouse manager.
  • Prepares reports for internal use and for potential prosecution. Enters cases into case management system Nettrack.
  • Maintains evidence collected and reports files from investigations.
  • Testifies in court concerning theft investigations.
  • Communicates with other area Costco Loss Prevention Clerks and Security people of area businesses to exchange information about current, local theft threats.
  • Ensures proper cleanup and disposal of hazardous materials.
  • Ability to operate vehicles, equipment or machinery.
  • Assists with department duties as necessary.
  • Assists in other departments of the warehouse as necessary.



For additional information about pay ranges, click here.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health benefits - medical/dental/vision/hearing aid/pharmacy/behavioral health/employee assistance, health care reimbursement account, dependent care assistance plan, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance, AD&D insurance, life insurance, 401(k), stock purchase plan to eligible employees.

Apart from any religious or disability considerations, open availability is needed to meet the needs of the business. If hired, you will be required to provide proof of authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Loss Prevention Associate

As a Loss Prevention Associate, you play an important role in protecting the company's assets. You have the opportunity to prevent loss and provide a secure environment for customers and employees.

What You'll Do:
  • Identify and reduce sources of loss from internal/external theft - control shrinkage
  • Apprehend shoplifters according to company directives and state laws
  • Maintain case log and incident reports
  • Conduct investigations including credit card and check fraud
  • Achieve individual case goals
  • Be available to work day, evening, and weekend shifts
What You Can Expect:

We're committed to helping you thrive at work and at home. We offer generous benefits that address your total well-being and provide support for you and your family.

  • Competitive wages
  • Generous merchandise discount
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, disability, term life insurance and flexible spending account
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • No extended holiday hours
  • Promote from within philosophy - creates endless career opportunities!

Von Maur's reputation as a company is directly tied to our legendary customer service. Still family owned today, our culture is built on supporting and valuing our employees who make it all possible. We're committed to being a great place to work, where you can take pride in your work and grow professionally.

The expected base wage for this position is $21.00 - $23.00/hr with overtime eligibility. Successful candidates' wages will be determined based on their individual qualifications for the position.

Pay range listed is provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may be different in other locations.
